annotations.title: Upload a playable ad to Meta

description: Upload a PLAYABLE ad (an interactive HTML game the advertiser already has) to a Meta ad account. Pass url: ONE HTML file up to 2 MB, or a zip up to 5 MB (under 100 files) with index.html at the top; it must call FbPlayableAd.onCTAClick() and load nothing from outside. Hermoso checks those rules first and refuses a file Meta would reject. Returns playableAssetId: build the ad with create_meta_ad(playableAssetId, adSetId of an App Installs ad set, ONE lead-in video). Meta has no way to delete a playable once uploaded. Free.

name.description: display name for the playable in Meta; optional

url.description: public https link to the HTML file or zip; upload_file turns a local file into one
